source_snapshot.procedure: 【Before Test】 verify SUT configuration and clear logs. 【During Test】 send in-band `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x02` on localhost. 【After Test】 collect results/photos and check logs.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Command should be sent without any error.
2. Check if BMC is alive and functional after reset complete.
3. BMC MAC Address and IP Address should not be changed.
4. System power status should not be effected.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass ... ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ... sudo ipmitool raw 0x06 0x02; sleep 90; sudo ipmitool mc info
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Return reset output and verify BMC with mc info.
deepseek_columns.risk: Reboots BMC and drops management; user request only.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL recognizes reset risk but uses insecure SSH, blind 90-second sleep and mc-info-only recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED adds explicit approval, independent recovery, readiness polling, MAC/IP/config and host-power comparison.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 992/2291 retained PARTIAL and displayed `mc reset cold`, not the preserved raw in-band command; generic operator gating omitted identity and recovery invariants.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Row 994 warm reset uses raw 0x06 0x03 and a different expected outage; this cold reset must retain its deeper reset semantics.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 preserves raw 0x06 0x02; ED-36 treats timeout/config values as readiness; ED-38 requires approval, one attempt and no automatic retry.

original_test_intent: Verify one in-band BMC cold reset completes, restores a functional BMC with unchanged MAC/IP, and leaves host power unaffected.
original_method: After explicit approval and baseline capture, issue raw 0x06 0x02 once through the verified in-band path, independently observe management outage/recovery, then compare network identity, services and host power.
manual_activity: Operator confirms target, maintenance window, active management workload and recovery channel immediately before the single cold reset; engineer owns anomaly handling and verdict.
required_inputs: Protected host access and explicit approval
safety_requirements: One reset only after explicit approval.
Do not use sshpass or disable host-key verification.
Do not clear logs before evidence collection.
Do not rely on fixed sleep or command acceptance as recovery proof.
Never use host power action as recovery.
On timeout or change, preserve evidence and escalate without retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect target, BMC network/config, services and host-power baseline.
Issue one protected in-band raw cold reset after approval.
Poll independent management readiness within bounded timeout.
Compare post-reset identity/config/health/power and return evidence without verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve cold-reset semantics, timing and recovery plan.
Decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and direct recovery on anomaly.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Raw 0x06 0x02 matches the Master, but insecure SSH and blind sleep are unacceptable; mc info alone cannot prove MAC/IP stability, service readiness or host-power invariance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use verified secret-safe host access, execute the preserved raw command once, and monitor BMC independently with bounded service/identity checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Cold-reset raw bytes, Script and 10/5-minute metadata are preserved; the DeepSeek 90 seconds remains historical rather than an assumed acceptance timeout.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Approved one-shot in-band cold reset with independent readiness and before/after invariants.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project BMC supporting IPMI cold reset through the verified host.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC firmware, ipmitool/interface and recovery monitor.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor cold-reset behavior plus Project management/host-power SLA.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds protected access, independent recovery monitoring and complete Criteria evidence without changing reset coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A high-level reset tool is an override and does not prove the raw in-band path unless equivalence is approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approval, baseline, readiness timeout and recovery channel.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold reset interrupts management and can strand the platform if network/services do not return.

project_override_considerations: An approved `mc reset cold`, Redfish or vendor reset may validate BMC cold-reset behavior but cannot claim the original raw in-band command path unless equivalent command handling and coverage are documented.
expected_evidence: Explicit approval and verified host/BMC/recovery path
Baseline MAC/IP/configuration, services, health and host power
Raw reset response plus timestamped outage/readiness timeline
No-clear/no-retry audit, recovery disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, raw cold-reset command and recovery/network/power Criteria are coherent; missing timeout/baseline details are Project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and pass conditions are technically defined. Execution waits for approval and safety inputs rather than an irreconcilable source conflict.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the raw reset but rejects insecure transport, fixed sleep and incomplete post-checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Confirms hybrid classification and comprehensive reset safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Restores raw-path coverage and adds objective recovery invariants.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps cold-reset downtime/coverage distinct from warm reset.

review_improvement: Makes reset acceptance depend on independent BMC recovery, stable identity/network and unchanged host power rather than a single delayed mc-info read.
independent_technical_reasoning: The reset sequence can be automated, but deliberate management interruption requires immediate human authorization and a verified recovery path. Those intrinsic approval/manual boundaries make REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION appropriate, while missing timeout values alone do not make it permanently BLOCKED.
